name: Roche CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Roche Holding AG is a healthcare research company operating through Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions. The pharmaceuticals division includes Roche Pharmaceuticals and Chugai, while diagnostics covers diabetes care, tissue and molecular diagnostics and centralized and point-of-care solutions. It was founded in 1896 by Fritz Hoffmann-La Roche and has its head office in Basel, Switzerland.
